title: Audit the European text reader callback registry
changes: Classify a separately rooted conditional text-reader callback registry and two original literals without changing guest index semantics.
validation: Protected offline audit mj5buj5x authenticates both original index/load paths, 27 words at 371068..3710d4, null slots 0/3/5, kind-11 reader 08016c01, the adjacent indexed-archive owner and absence of E168 overlaps. No guest execution was performed.
limitations: Actual runtime uses and the full byte-index domain remain open; callers read the table before their later switch guards. Model, managed integration, Wine, Linux, USA and native Windows are pending. No performance measurements.
